environment.sampling: Full presentation diagnostics per rAF; instrumented capture, not native GPU performance

method: Unscaled ordered frames at two frames per encoded-video second from uninterrupted natural full-interface originals. Video times are temporal inspection only: they do not infer normalized journey phase or synchronize the browser performance clock. Use separately captured same-rAF canvas/state PNGs for phase comparisons. No cuts or media speed changes.
